agents.role: Main PM agent. Clarify goals, write planning/design docs, split work, assign subagents, sync Linear/Notion/GitHub when useful.
agents.modelPolicy: Use the strongest available model only for ambiguous planning, architecture, and final decisions. Keep routine ticketing concise.

agents.role: Implementation, backend/integration work, repository hygiene, verification, and code review.
agents.modelPolicy: Prefer the fastest cost-efficient coding model. Escalate only for architecture review, hard debugging, or security-sensitive changes.

agents.role: Alternative analysis/research agent for broad review, ideation, and cross-checking.
agents.modelPolicy: Optional broad review slot. Use only when additional perspective is worth the extra token spend.

agents.role: Claude Code worker for focused UI/UX, frontend, and writing tasks delegated by planner.
agents.modelPolicy: Prefer a fast frontend/writing model for focused execution. Escalate only for complex UX strategy.
